bio: Senior Research Scientist Biostatistics, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health Departments Department of Biostatistics Kristin Baltrusaitis, PhD, is a Research Scientist at the Center for Biostatistics in AIDS Research (CBAR), Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health. As a Research Scientist, she contributes to the study design, monitoring, and analysis of multiple studies that evaluate prevention and treatment interventions for HIV and HIV-associated complications and co-morbidities in infants, children, and adolescents, and during pregnancy and postpartum. Her primary independent research interests are in pediatric Phase I/II clinical trial design, sensitivity analyses for missing data in cluster randomized trials, and growth and developmental outcomes in children who are HIV-exposed but uninfected (CHEU). BS, Biochemistry Lehigh University
